# Usea Depth: Central Usea. Generated by tools/usea_depth/fcu/build.py; do not edit by hand.
# Government changes happen only in the ac_ud_fcu_regime_* effects below (seams.regime_effect).
ac_ud_fcu_regime_directorate = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { neutrality = 55 democratic = 35 communism = 5 fascism = 5 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = FCU_ud_directorate_office } } recruit_character = FCU_ud_directorate_office }
	promote_character = { character = FCU_ud_directorate_office ideology = stratocracy }
}
ac_ud_fcu_regime_unity = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { democratic = 85 neutrality = 5 communism = 5 fascism = 5 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = FCU_ud_unity_office } } recruit_character = FCU_ud_unity_office }
	promote_character = { character = FCU_ud_unity_office ideology = centrism }
}
ac_ud_fcu_regime_restoration = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { democratic = 80 neutrality = 10 communism = 5 fascism = 5 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = FCU_robert_sinclair } } recruit_character = FCU_robert_sinclair }
	promote_character = { character = FCU_robert_sinclair ideology = centrism }
}

ac_ud_fcu_readiness_init = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = FCU_ud_readiness } } set_variable = { FCU_ud_readiness = 0 } }
}

ac_ud_fcu_bound = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = FCU_ud_readiness } clamp_variable = { var = FCU_ud_readiness min = 0 max = 100 } }
}

# Chronicle, 1999 / 07.08. Read once; a save first loaded after the tree switch records the impact as past.
ac_ud_fcu_impact_tally = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FCU NOT = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_tallied } }
		set_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_tallied
		ac_ud_fcu_readiness_init = yes
		if = {
			limit = { date < 1999.12.1 NOT = { has_global_flag = ac_ucw_calendar_started } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { FCU_ud_readiness > 59 } }
				set_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_prepared
				add_timed_idea = { idea = FCU_ud_impact_aftershock_light_idea days = 180 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { FCU_ud_readiness > 29 } }
				set_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_strained
				add_timed_idea = { idea = FCU_ud_impact_aftershock_idea days = 270 }
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_overwhelmed
				add_timed_idea = { idea = FCU_ud_impact_aftershock_severe_idea days = 365 }
			}
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_fcu.26 days = 14 }
		}
	}
}

# Once-only carry-over after the December 1999 tree switch, once the Continental War owner marks FCU as started.
# It reads the Continental War owner's flags and index; it never sets an ac_ucw flag.
ac_ud_fcu_carryover = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FCU has_country_flag = ac_ucw_started NOT = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_carryover_done } }
		set_country_flag = FCU_ud_carryover_done
		ac_ud_fcu_readiness_init = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { FCU_ud_readiness > 59 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_ucw_recovery } add_to_variable = { ac_ucw_recovery = 3 } ac_ucw_bound = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_relief_lane_corps has_country_flag = FCU_ud_relief_lane_treaty has_country_flag = FCU_ud_relief_lane_military }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_relief_lane_finished }
			}
			remove_ideas = FCU_ud_relief_corps_idea
			remove_ideas = FCU_ud_treaty_relief_idea
			remove_ideas = FCU_ud_military_relief_idea
			add_timed_idea = { idea = FCU_ud_relief_work_continues_idea days = 365 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date < 2001.1.1 }
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_fcu.30 days = 7 }
		}
	}
}

ac_ud_fcu_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FCU date > 1999.7.7 NOT = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_impact_tallied } }
		ac_ud_fcu_impact_tally = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FCU has_country_flag = ac_ucw_started NOT = { has_country_flag = FCU_ud_carryover_done } }
		ac_ud_fcu_carryover = yes
	}
}
